observations: Two car headlight assemblies wrapped in clear plastic film.
The plastic film shows significant wrinkles and creasing, suggesting it has been handled or stored for some time.
The headlight housings appear to be aftermarket parts, not original factory parts.
No brand logos, model badges, or identification plates are visible on the front of the housings.
The interior of the housings is not visible, so the condition of the bulb and lens is unknown.
